description: This file defines the LeaveApplicationService class, which handles leave application logic including applying for leave, validating leave requests, managing leave statuses, and dispatching related events within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeaveApplicationService
classes.description: Service class for handling leave applications, including validation, saving requests, and managing workflow states within the HRM system.

methods.name: applyLeave
methods.description: Creates a new leave application after validating against maximum allowed leave period, overlapping leaves, and work shift length.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Saves the leave request, handles entitlements, comments, and dispatches leave application events.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the leave status based on whether the day falls on a weekend, holiday, or a pending approval, considering workflow states.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether leave balance can be exceeded; returns false in this implementation.

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForApplyAction
methods.description: Retrieves the workflow item associated with the 'APPLY' action for leave requests.
